summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change set payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so orders were processed without payment. Order worker stalled in a wait state (heartbeat stale), so the queue backed up. Its underlying cause is unknown.
recommended: Confirm that payments-v2 is reachable and correct before retrying the provider migration.
Find out why the worker stalled in its wait state.
Add alerting on worker heartbeat age and on payment provider call failures.

events.text: Something may be wrong with the order system. No other details.

version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
I'm seeing two problems: the provider URL is pointing to an unreachable payments-v2 endpoint, and a worker is stuck waiting on queue 36. I should fix the config to use v1 first.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.

Still broken:
- [business] payment_gap: 22 of 111 orders were processed but have no payment.
- [business] worker_stalled: Worker heartbeat is 17s old (queue depth 75).
- [business] queue_backlog: Queue depth 75 and growing (was 66).
Payments are fixed, so the worker is next. It's stuck.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
